articles.summary: A retry storm saturated our shared Python webhook servers. We rebuilt the busiest path in Rust, raising tested throughput from about 30 to more than 400 requests per second while moving that traffic off the shared Python fleet.
articles.title: Why we rebuilt our busiest webhook endpoint in Rust

articles.title: The Velocity of Value: Forward Deployed Engineering at Nash
